_doc: Look of melee attacks, read only by src/render/vfx.js (no game rule reads it). 'weapons' sets the blade trail that follows the real weapon tip while a melee skill swings: tip/base are distances along the weapon (m, grip at 0, blade along +Z), life is how long a trail segment glows, minSpeed/fullSpeed (m/s of the tip) fade the trail in only while the blade is really moving, zone is the strength of the ground wedge that flashes where the hit area is (its size is the skill's range and arc), dust is the puff kicked up on contact. 'monsters' gives one look per melee attack name from data/monsters.json; 'overrides' tweaks it for one monster (type.attack). focus marks a weapon whose tip gathers a spell's cast glow (otherwise the right hand does). 'skills' gives a cartoon look per combat skill id from data/skills.json (style target: Cartoon FX, see docs/VFX-REFERENCE.md), in three beats: cast (fire light swelling at the focus for castTime), travel (after the owner's reference GIF: a glowing white-hot head (core) in an orange glow, a ragged fire ring at launch, a long churning trail of hand-drawn flame wisps pointing back along the path that char toward charColor at their ends, small torn-off flecks and embers, a pool of light on the ground; no smoke; rates are per second) and impact (shake and hitStop give it weight; a white spiky flash and wide ground light, a see-through sphere of light going white to yellow to red, a yellow comic burst and long thin needles; after fireballDelay a lumpy ball of fire that burns out by shrinking, with no smoke). Sizes are metres. Fire colours come from the skill's element so element mods still recolour it.
